scope: Whole independently placed central round process basin at Olympic Dam, preserving all nineteen original numerical outer controls. Complete foundation, exterior shell, inner liner, thick rim, recessed dark process surface and estimated central maintenance bridge. Other mine vessels, buildings, conveyors and shafts remain separate.

references.caption: View of Earth taken during ISS Expedition 38.

references.appearanceUse: Dark circular process-surface and rim morphology in the central group only; individual height, process function, fine equipment and exact date continuity remain estimated.

notes: Already-cleared published Qualla NASA ISS038-E-29810 original shows the central group of dark circular process surfaces, including a larger ring beside two rows of smaller rings. A bounded visual numerical-plan comparison supports this broad basin morphology; this is not surveyed photo registration or verified individual process identity. Model uses the original numerical outline and an estimated low open vessel section. Specific height, shell material, surface level, hub, maintenance bridge, access details, exact process function and2014-to2026 continuity remain unmeasured. No photo texture, report graphics or other imagery.
